notes.title: News about our new projects
notes.content:
Hi everyone! Today we’ll tell you about some news of our studio and what we’re working on at the moment. We would be glad if you get interested in our latest games.

[h1]1) Bus World Announcement[/h1]
This is a game about disasters and driving various buses.
Bus World is not a usual simulator. You will have to rescue people in extreme conditions. Moreover, you will experience technical difficulties. And finally, one of the maps is Chernobyl Exclusion Zone!
Take a look at the trailer:
[previewyoutube=OwDMk9xHoOc;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1193090/Bus_World/]Here is the page of the game[/url], and you can add it to Wishlist right now.








[h1]2) Bus Driver Simulator 2019. [/h1]
A bus simulator, where you can drive around real cities - Serpukhov, Russia and Cologne, Germany.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/12132904/86a98542023fafbe0967f25c58c10689eb0b08de.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/12132904/722ca282e2595b01a38b4abbe5b318e0af231c05.jpg[/img]
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/679260/Bus_Driver_..]Steam Page[/url]

[h1]3) Metro Simulator 2019. [/h1]
Simulator of Metro Train driver. Several lines of Moscow Metro are recreated!

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/994890/Metro_Simul..]Steam Page[/url]

We're going to announce our new game soon, so stay tuned! All the new information goes here:
[url=https://www.facebook.com/KishMishGames/]Facebook[/url]
[url=https://twitter.com/KishMishStudio]Twitter[/url]
[url=https://vk.com/kishmishgames]VK[/url]

notes.title: Update 1/10/2017
notes.content:
We have corrected typos and punctuation errors. 

Now we are focused on our new game "The Agony" ([url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/568720/]Store page[/url]). We think it will appeal to everyone who enjoyed the "Sixtieth Kilometer." But we also have plans for “Sixtieth Kilometer”. We want to release a DLC with a short story. In it you will learn about what happened to the world after the pink fog disappeared. Of course, you will meet familiar characters. Some of them were not as deep and interesting as we wanted in the original version, and we're going to fix it. How do you like this idea? Write your opinion in the comments!

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/12132904/52d4342f2d0553648196de1784a56ac49ea0811b.png[/img]

notes.title: Update
notes.content:
We're fixed several mistakes in dialogues, story lines and translation.
The development of the novel "Sixtieth Kilometer" started in the end of 2014 and the story was written back in 2011-2012! The project faced many difficulties since then and we had to change artists and translators several times. We hope you like the result! 

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/12132904/45ba0c049b71786fb855d518d6846ec6100437d7.jpg[/img]

Also we're developing a new visual novel that is a spiritual successor of the Sixtieth Kilometer. It's called "The Agony". We are working really hard to make this new project even better. You can support us and vote for the game in [url=http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=759966989] Steam Greenlight! [/url]
